policy: Numerical parameter bounds are allowed; missing topology is not silently substituted.

blockers.required: Connect the complete 012-6931 converter/regulators and external 12 V input; replace ideal internal rails.
Connect phase detector, reactance-controlled oscillator, driver, booster, output and recovery networks; no prescribed scan waveform.

The connected 76-part vertical bench now includes A3, power output and R/L yoke feedback with no dummy ramp load. Connect its actual converter rails and assembly yoke; bound P09A-family/output-device uncertainty. C15 remains an unresolved-value assumption.

Review assembly interconnect and T3 internal winding/tap map including polarity; the connector block alone does not establish all internal sections. Resolve printed design separately from handwritten alterations.
Implement and bound controller protection/recovery and loaded-output validity, plus MAA723/P09A models and magnetic/yoke models before circuit-level publication.
Connect the electrothermal CRT current model to actual solved heater/electrode rails, remove duplicate constant loads, and audit grid/interception/beam current accounting.
Implement electrical/thermal state continuation and demonstrate equivalence to uninterrupted runs before warm-up checkpoints; no DC restart at checkpoints.
Pass connected startup/lock, electrical/optical/thermal refinement, service-waveform comparison and actual firmware-frame rendering. Independent optical traces cannot pass this gate.

transformer_evidence.finding: Manufacturer description identifies U52/54 core, HV terminals 1 and 16, booster operation and third-harmonic tuning. This constrains the model but does not specify all winding sections/taps and polarity.
Repair is for a K7222.25 and changes the HV cold-end connection. Replacement turns/resistance and winding placement are not a factory map for the .11 transformer.
External tap/interconnect corroboration only; no complete original winding/polarity specification. Colored reconstruction must not replace the factory drawing.
Rejected for K7222 T3 mapping: this article identifies UHA75, not UHA78.
